cpuThrottle.scope: openProbe and after-open counters precede CPU throttling; subsequent netplay setup and first game callback use the configured per-side rates.

headedLaunch.scope: Window-mode environment control, not a production code change; proxy, input, audio/context, CPU setup, and native GPU arguments are unchanged.

confirmed.note: Final speculative hashes are retained, not compared; same next/confirmed counters do not imply same speculative input history.

continuous.definition: Half-open callback cohort [first F>=180, first F>=1800); retain end marker to close elapsed, counter deltas and final new-state gap. F is PredictionFrontier, not rewound next.

pacing.samplingCaveat: Callback-end sample is not entry scale; timer pumps and fresh progress can occur between pacing observations.

splitRecovery.definition: Episodes of R>0 callback-end observations; duration starts at the first observed partial endpoint, not the start of Restore/CPU work, and ends at the first observed R=0 or censored endpoint.

legacyCohortBoundary.definition: Raw harness filters every sample by rewound next in [180,1800), then differences consecutive retained rows.

costPartition.definition: Every sampled callback cost belongs exactly once to prefix [0,start), body [start,end), or tail [end,sampleCount); endpoint callback belongs to tail body cost while its counters close the boundary progress metric.

startupAndTail.scope: Startup and tail retained; no excluded sample is relabelled a clean performance result.

injection.packetScope: E9NP version 4 kind 1; ACK-only and redundant input included; non-input control/hash/signaling untouched; relay has no separate RTC repair lane.
injection.jitterAlgorithm: Per-sender LCG 1664525*x+1013904223, seed 0x915ab+sender; same formula as legacy client impairment. Relay forwarding order can differ.
injection.burstClock: First non-empty E9NP input receive in this relay process; distinct from browser active time.

relay.scope: Same-host separate Node relay process; scheduled/send are process API boundaries. NETWORK_TRACE=0 means browser message, poll-copy and native acceptance times are unavailable. No inferred end-to-end/remote-WAN latency.

raw.scope: Read-only host CPU counters and candidate process CPU counters. No performance samples are excluded or reweighted.
limitations: Aggregate CPU occupancy does not establish single-core availability, CPU frequency, thermal state, GPU load, or a stable benchmark environment.
Process names are candidates for contention, not proof that a process is compiling. Known harness/relay/helper PIDs are labeled separately; other node processes remain unlabeled candidates.
Process CPU is cumulative lifetime CPU seconds. A first sighting is not CPU consumed during this run; PID reuse or counter reset can break a delta.
The 5 s process snapshots miss short tasks that start and exit between snapshots. Timer delays and source/receive times are retained.
This observer has overhead. Its own PowerShell helper is intentionally not a candidate process, but its work is included in aggregate CPU counters.
Overflow and sampling failures make this evidence incomplete; they are never a reason to silently remove a game result.

host.limits: CPU busy values are host aggregate; 5s candidate-process sampling misses short-lived work. Deltas require same PID/name in consecutive observations and exclude first-observed lifetime CPU. No performance samples removed, reweighted or baseline-divided.

conclusions: The original P2 83.735ms filtered RAF gap joins samples 5728 and 5739 across ten excluded tail samples after first F=1800. It is not one request waiting 83.735ms. Preserve original summary and show continuous monotonic-frontier window separately.

Continuous marker-to-marker logical throughput is about 40.61Hz on both peers. Actual-input-gap scale is active through nearly all that window; P2 also splits replay. Do not divide elapsed or infer exact pacing duty from callback-end scale.
P2 partial replay and caught-up-without-fresh returns are explicit recovery work; the raw ok=2 callbacks examined have positive replay increments, not a demonstrated hard-window no-progress wait.

Neither supplied 125ms nor median scale establishes actual rollback depth. The observed F/A deficit and remaining replay work are reported separately; correction counts include only each explicitly defined window.

No claim of physical scanout, audible continuity, public network robustness, absence of host competition, or cause of prior seconds-long RAF stalls follows from this run. Input responsiveness/audio are analyzed separately.
